zh.title: 1. 概述与适用范围
body: 1.1 本条款说明 Lumen Android 客户端（下称“本应用”）如何处理与个人信息有关的数据。控制者为本应用的开发者（下称“我方”）。
1.2 本条款不适用于你自行部署的音乐服务器；该服务器由你或第三方运营，其数据实践由其自行负责。
1.3 核心设计原则：数据尽量留在设备与你的服务器之间；本应用不设开发者云端账号，不进行用户画像广告投放。

en.title: 1. Overview and scope
body: 1.1 This policy explains how the Lumen Android client (“App”) handles personal data. The controller is the developer of the App (“we”).
1.2 This policy does not apply to the music server you operate; that server is run by you or a third party, who is responsible for its own practices.
1.3 Design principle: data stays between your device and your server wherever possible. There is no developer-operated cloud account and no advertising profiling.

zh.title: 2. 我们不收集的数据
body: 2.1 我方不接收你的音频文件、曲库元数据、服务器地址或服务器凭据。
2.2 本应用不含埋点统计、广告 SDK 或第三方行为分析 SDK。
2.3 端侧音频分析在设备内完成，音频数据不会传输至我方。

en.title: 2. What we do not collect
body: 2.1 We do not receive your audio files, library metadata, server address or server credentials.
2.2 The App contains no analytics, advertising SDKs or third-party behavioural tracking.
2.3 On-device audio analysis runs locally; audio is never transmitted to us.

zh.title: 3. 设备端处理的本地数据
body: 3.1 为提供服务，本应用在设备内处理并保存：服务器地址与账号、登录令牌、播放与最近播放记录、评分与收藏、下载与缓存文件、设置项。
3.2 音频分析结果包括：CLAP 音乐特征向量（1024 维）、音频标签与段落标签、情绪坐标（valence / arousal）、节拍与能量包络。上述数据默认仅写入本机数据库。
3.3 除你主动配置的同步或导出功能外，上述数据不会离开设备。

en.title: 3. Local data processed on your device
body: 3.1 To provide the Service the App processes and stores on your device: server address and account, authentication token, playback and recent-play records, ratings and favourites, downloads and cache, and preferences.

3.2 Analysis results include: CLAP music embeddings (1024-dim), audio and segment tags, valence/arousal coordinates, beat positions and energy envelope. By default these are written only to the local database.
3.3 Except for sync or export features you actively configure, this data does not leave the device.

zh.title: 4. 权限与用途
body: 4.1 网络权限：连接你指定的服务器以播放、同步与下载。
4.2 存储/文件访问：保存离线下载与缓存；仅在系统要求的范围内使用。
4.3 前台服务与电池优化豁免（如启用）：在后台继续播放或分析；你可随时在系统中关闭。
4.4 本应用不请求通讯录、短信、通话记录、精确位置、麦克风或摄像头权限。

en.title: 4. Permissions and purposes
body: 4.1 Network: connect to your server for playback, sync and downloads.
4.2 Storage/file access: save offline downloads and cache, limited to what the platform requires.
4.3 Foreground service and battery-optimisation exemption (if enabled): continue playback or analysis in the background; you can revoke this in system settings at any time.
4.4 The App does not request contacts, SMS, call logs, precise location, microphone or camera access.

zh.title: 5. 处理的法律依据（如适用）
body: 5.1 履行合同：为提供你请求的播放、下载与分析功能所必需的处理。
5.2 正当利益：保障应用安全、排错与改进所必需的最小处理（如崩溃信息由你选择是否提供）。
5.3 同意：在你主动开启端侧分析以外的可选功能（如联网获取封面）时。
5.4 法定义务：在适用法律要求时。

en.title: 5. Legal bases (where applicable)
body: 5.1 Performance of a contract: processing necessary to provide the playback, download and analysis features you request.
5.2 Legitimate interests: minimal processing for security, troubleshooting and improvement (e.g. crash information you choose to share).
5.3 Consent: for optional features beyond on-device analysis that you enable (e.g. fetching artwork online).
5.4 Legal obligation: where required by applicable law.

zh.title: 6. 第三方与共享
body: 6.1 本应用不向开发者回传数据，也不出售或出租个人信息。
6.2 仅在你配置相应功能时，数据可能流向：你的自建服务器；系统提供的图片加载与字体服务；应用商店的崩溃与安装统计（由平台按其政策处理）。
6.3 开源组件（如 ONNX Runtime、Coil）在设备本地运行，不主动外传数据。

en.title: 6. Third parties and sharing
body: 6.1 We do not receive your data and never sell or rent personal information.

6.2 Data may reach: your self-hosted server; platform-provided image loading and font services; and store-level crash/install analytics, only where you enable such features and subject to the platform's policy.
6.3 Open-source components (e.g. ONNX Runtime, Coil) run locally and do not transmit data on their own.

zh.title: 7. 跨境传输
body: 7.1 我方不进行个人信息的跨境传输。
7.2 你连接位于其他辖区的服务器时，数据流动由你自行决定并负责；你应确保该传输符合适用的跨境规则。

en.title: 7. International transfers
body: 7.1 We do not transfer personal data across borders.
7.2 When you connect to a server in another jurisdiction, you decide and are responsible for that flow; you must ensure it complies with applicable transfer rules.

zh.title: 8. 保存期限
body: 8.1 本地数据在应用存续期间保留，直至你卸载应用或在设置中清除本机数据。
8.2 你主动清除数据后，相关记录即从本机数据库删除；缓存文件随之移除。
8.3 我方不设服务器端存储，故无独立的保留期限。

en.title: 8. Retention
body: 8.1 Local data is retained while the App is installed, until you uninstall it or clear local data in settings.
8.2 After you clear data, records are deleted from the local database and cache files are removed.
8.3 We operate no server-side storage, so there is no separate retention period.

zh.title: 9. 安全
body: 9.1 本应用依赖操作系统提供的应用沙箱与文件权限隔离本地数据。
9.2 与服务器的通信使用你配置的协议与传输方式；建议启用 HTTPS/TLS 并避免在不可信网络中使用明文连接。
9.3 任何系统均无法保证绝对安全；如发现安全缺陷，请通过应用内「设置 → 问题反馈」所列的官方渠道报告。

en.title: 9. Security
body: 9.1 The App relies on the operating system's app sandbox and file permissions to isolate local data.
9.2 Communication with your server uses the protocol you configure; we recommend HTTPS/TLS and discourage plaintext connections on untrusted networks.
9.3 No system can be absolutely secure; report vulnerabilities through the official channel listed under Settings → Feedback in the App.

zh.title: 10. 你的权利
body: 10.1 在适用法律范围内，你享有访问、更正、删除、限制处理、反对处理与数据可携的权利。
10.2 由于数据主要存储于你的设备，多数权利可自行行使：清除本机数据、卸载应用、修改设置。
10.3 如需行使其他权利，请通过应用内「设置 → 问题反馈」所列的官方渠道联系我们；你也有权向住所地监管机构投诉。

en.title: 10. Your rights
body: 10.1 To the extent provided by law, you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability.
10.2 Because data is mostly on your device, most rights are self-service: clear local data, uninstall the App, adjust settings.
10.3 For other requests, contact us through the official channel listed under Settings → Feedback in the App; you may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.

zh.title: 11. 儿童
body: 11.1 本应用不面向未成年人独立使用；若你未达到所在地的法定成年年龄，请在监护人同意并指导下使用。
11.2 如你认为未成年人向我们提供了信息，请通过第 10 条所列渠道联系我们，我们将予以删除。

en.title: 11. Children
body: 11.1 The App is not intended for independent use by minors; if you are below the age of majority where you live, use it only with a guardian's consent and guidance.
11.2 If you believe a minor provided information to us, contact us through the channel in Section 10 and we will delete it.

zh.title: 12. Cookie 与追踪
body: 12.1 本应用不使用 Cookie、广告标识符或跨应用追踪技术。

en.title: 12. Cookies and tracking
body: 12.1 The App uses no cookies, advertising identifiers or cross-app tracking.

zh.title: 13. 本条款的变更
body: 13.1 如处理方式发生实质变化，我方将更新本页并调整生效日期，必要时在应用内提示。
13.2 继续使用即视为接受更新后的条款；不同意时应停止使用并卸载应用。

en.title: 13. Changes to this policy
body: 13.1 If our practices change materially we will update this page and its effective date, with in-app notice where appropriate.
13.2 Continued use constitutes acceptance; if you disagree, stop using and uninstall the App.

zh.title: 14. 联系方式与生效
body: 14.1 数据保护联系人：应用内「设置 → 问题反馈」所列的官方渠道。
14.2 我方未在欧盟境内设立代表；欧盟用户如需行使《通用数据保护条例》项下权利，请通过第 10 条所列渠道联系我们。
14.3 生效日期：本页所示版本日期。

en.title: 14. Contact and effective date
body: 14.1 Data protection contact: the official channel listed under Settings → Feedback in the App.
14.2 We have not appointed an EU representative; EU users may exercise GDPR rights by contacting us through the channel in Section 10.
14.3 Effective date: the version date shown on this page.
